name: Merak
description: A naked-eye star 24.5 parsecs away, 3.0 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 95418: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.149 +/- 0.014 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 3.021 +/- 0.038

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 95418: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 9377 +/- 75

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 856096765753549056 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 95418: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 40.89 +/- 0.16 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 24 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 3.0 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 1.149 milliarcseconds, which gives 3.021 solar radii and 9,377 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 95418: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
